output.summary: Today I walked to the mill but the miller's son wasn't there or didn't deal—I didn't get any flour, and I didn't tell Pedro straight. I ended up eating bread I bought at the market, twice, and went to bed without writing in my book. I spent coins on bread and still owe Pedro his ten, and the inn still feels empty.
insights: I can't promise Pedro anything until I actually have flour in my hands; talk is cheap.
The market has bread, but that's not the same as having my own oven working.
I'm mayor now, but that doesn't feed anyone; I need to act, not just plan.
